name: Zscaler MCP Server
description: Zscaler MCP Server — AI-powered management of the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange across ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, ZCC, ZTW, ZIdentity, EASM, Z-Insights, ZMS, and ZCell via the Model Context Protocol.
long_description: Zscaler MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for managing Zscaler products with LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.). It exposes hundreds of tools across the Zscaler services. Read-only operations are available by default; create / update / delete tools require explicit allowlisting via the 'Enable Write Tools' and 'Write Tools Allowlist' settings below, and destructive operations additionally require an in-session HMAC confirmation token.

enabled_services.title: Enabled Services
enabled_services.description: Comma-separated list of Zscaler services to enable. Available: zia, zpa, zdx, zcc, ztw, zid, zeasm, zins, zms, zcell. Default: every service the OneAPI credentials are entitled to.

toolsets.title: Enabled Toolsets
toolsets.description: Comma-separated list of toolset ids to enable (e.g. 'zia_url_filtering,zpa_app_segments'). Special values: 'default' for the curated default-on subset, 'all' for every toolset. Leave empty to load every toolset for the enabled services.

debug_mode.title: Enable Debug Mode
debug_mode.description: Enable debug logging for troubleshooting. Logs all MCP operations and outbound API interactions to the Claude Desktop developer console.

enable_write_tools.title: Enable Write Tools
enable_write_tools.description: Enable tools that CREATE, UPDATE, or DELETE Zscaler resources. Read-only tools (list / get) remain available regardless of this setting. Off by default.

write_tools.title: Write Tools Allowlist (MANDATORY when writes are enabled)
write_tools.description: Comma-separated allowlist of write tools. Supports fnmatch wildcards (e.g. 'zpa_create_*,zia_update_*'). Required when 'Enable Write Tools' is on — an empty allowlist registers zero write tools even with the toggle enabled.

user_agent_comment.title: Custom User Agent
user_agent_comment.description: Optional comment appended to the SDK's outgoing User-Agent header. Useful for tagging requests when a single tenant has multiple deployments.

client_id.title: ZSCALER_CLIENT_ID
client_id.description: OneAPI client ID from the ZIdentity console.

client_secret.title: ZSCALER_CLIENT_SECRET
client_secret.description: OneAPI client secret from the ZIdentity console.

customer_id.title: ZSCALER_CUSTOMER_ID
customer_id.description: Zscaler customer/tenant ID. Required for ZPA tools; optional for other services.

zcell_customer_id.title: ZCELL_CUSTOMER_ID
zcell_customer_id.description: Zscaler Cellular customer ID. Required for ZCell tools. Separate from ZSCALER_CUSTOMER_ID (used by ZPA).

cloud.title: ZSCALER_CLOUD
cloud.description: Optional Zscaler cloud override (e.g. 'BETA', 'zscalertwo'). Leave as 'production' for the standard cloud.
